x-values.description:
Ships and ground vehicles: `EntityClassDefinition` Records under `entities/spaceships` and
`entities/groundvehicles`.

Quality quantizations: `CraftingQualityQuantizationRecord` Records under
`crafting/qualityquantization`, each linked to the `ResourceType`s that use it.

Dismantle processes: `CraftingBlueprintRecord` Records under
`crafting/blueprints/dismantle` whose process is a `GenericCraftingProcess_Dismantle`.

Paints: the items whose `AttachDef.Type` is `Paints`, with the ships they fit. Derived from
the items and ships, so no record-path rule of its own.

Loadouts: the ports of every ship and of every item that has ports, with the Entity the
Default Loadout attaches to each. Derived from the items and ships, so no record-path rule
of its own.

Starmap objects: `StarMapObject` Records under `starmap/pu`, each with the position the
system containers place it at.

Contracts: every contract and every sub contract of the `ContractGenerator` Records under
`contracts/contractgenerator`, one entry each.

Harvestable locations: the containers whose `.soc` names a provider preset, with the
starmap object they hang below. Derived from the system containers, so no record-path rule
of its own.

Shops: the `ShopBackup` entries of the shop registry `LayerBackups.xml`, with kind and brand
from the shop containers. Derived from Archive files, so no record-path rule of its own.
Physical Loot V3 secondary single-layer choice Records.
Physical Loot V3 secondary multi-layer choice Records.
Physical Hierarchical Contextual Data preset Records.
Physical Loot Generation global parameter Records.

Loot containers: the containers whose placing entity carries a multi config, read from the
entity files of the containers below the system containers. Derived from Archive files, so
no record-path rule of its own.

Mineable entities: `EntityClassDefinition` Records under `entities/mineable`, the rocks and
deposits with their scan signature.

Older loot tables: `LootTable` Records under `lootgeneration/loottables`, which the
`lootTable` of a slot's `lootConfig` links to.

Crafters: the entities whose `Components` hold a `CrafterComponentParams`. The rule takes
the `EntityClassDefinition` Records under `entities` that no earlier kind takes, so it
comes last; an item, ship or commodity that is a crafter is read from its own Record.
[`Kind::rule`] alone does not select a crafter: the Record must also hold the component.

Mission location templates: `MissionLocationTemplate` Records under
`missiondata/pu_locations`, what a location query of a contract matches by tags.

Contract ship spawns: the distinct ship spawn descriptions the contracts state. Derived from
the contracts, so no record-path rule of its own.

Contract location queries: the distinct location queries the contracts state. Derived from
the contracts, so no record-path rule of its own.

Contract templates: every `ContractTemplate` Record, whatever its folder, the structure a
contract names in `templateGuid`.

Mission broker entries: every `MissionBrokerEntry` Record, whatever its folder, the offers
of the mission board.
Contract NPC spawns: the distinct NPC spawn descriptions. Derived, so no record-path rule.
Contract entity spawns: the distinct entity spawn descriptions. Derived, so no rule either.
Authored Generator property arrays, shared by all contract rows that reference them.
Global Tag definitions, with `TagDatabase` roots as source dependencies.
Authored lists: every `BlueprintCategoryDatabaseRecord` under the ordinary Filter.
Original offline shop inventory JSON files in the Archive.
All physically typed reputation perk-list Records.
All physical sandbox reputation trigger definition Records.
All physical reputation reward amount Records.
Physical reusable sets of ordered infraction uses.
Physical weighted NPC class pool Records.
Physical shared medical tier and consumption configuration Records.
Physical `MissionScenario` Records selected by their exact type.
Physical module declarations linked by objective handlers and other modules.
Physical global definitions of the authored contract scope labels and icons.

Loadout.description: The ports of a ship or of an item that has ports, and what the Default Loadout puts into them.

entityGuid.description:
The `guid` of the entry in `ships` or `items` the ports belong to; loadouts are ordered by
it.

entityKind.description:
Which kind `entityGuid` is an entry of, `ship` or `item`; a closed set the game may
extend, so the schema keeps a string.

issues.description:
The codes of the problems that kept part of the Loadout from being read, e.g.
`xml_loadout`, sorted and without duplicates; empty when everything was read.

ports.description:
The ports of the Entity: those a Loadout names in Loadout order, then the other defined
ports in definition order, then the item ports of the vehicle implementation no Record
port names.

displayNameKey.description: The localisation key of the port's display name; `null` for none or a placeholder key.

dockedVehicle.description:
Whether the attached Entity is a docked vehicle, e.g. a snub craft in a hangar port. Its
ports are not listed.

flags.description:
The flags of the port as stored, split at white space, without a leading `$`, e.g.
`invisible`, `uneditable`.

itemClassName.description:
The class name of the attached Entity, or the class name the Loadout names; `null` for an
empty port or an unresolved Reference.

itemGuid.description:
The `guid` of the entry in `items` (or, for a docked vehicle, in `ships`) the port holds
by default; `null` for an empty port. For an attachment that cannot be resolved it is the
GUID the Loadout names, which may belong to no entry, or `null` when the Loadout names a
class name only.

maxSize.description: The largest item size the port takes, `null` when the data gives none.

minSize.description: The smallest item size the port takes, `null` when the data gives none.

name.description: The port name, as the Loadout or the port definition spells it.

portTags.description:
The tags the port offers: the words of the stored value, split at white space and
otherwise unchanged, like `tags` of an item.

ports.description:
The ports of the attached Entity under this Loadout, or the ports of the nested Loadout of
an empty port; empty for a port without either.

requiredTags.description:
The tags an item must carry to fit the port: the words of the stored value, split at white
space and otherwise unchanged, like `tags` of an item.

source.description:
Where the attachment comes from: `loadout` (the Entity's own Default Loadout), `override`
(the Loadout of the entry that attached the Entity), `port_default` (the default item of
the port definition), `unset` (the port is defined and holds nothing) or `vehicle` (the
port is known only from the vehicle implementation and holds nothing). A closed set the
game may extend, so the schema keeps a string.

sourceConstraints.description: Physical source configuration links for the port definition and attached Entity.

types.description: The item types the port takes, in stored order; empty when the data names none.

unresolved.description:
The code of the error that kept the attachment from being resolved, e.g.
`dangling_reference` or `unknown_class`; `null` otherwise.

visibility.description:
Whether the port shows its item: `visible` or `invisible` as the vehicle implementation's
part of that name says; without such a part `invisible` when the port definition carries
the flag `invisible`, else `unspecified`. A closed set the game may extend, so the schema
keeps a string.

en.description:

the elements one rock or deposit is made of.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `Asteroid_CType_Iron`.

depositName.description:
The HUD label of the deposit, from `depositName`. The localisation key and the texts are
game texts.

minimumDistinctElements.description: `minimumDistinctElements`, from 1 to 4 on LIVE; `null` when the Record states none.

parts.description: The parts, from `compositionArray` in stored order.

MineableElement.description:
A mineable element: a `MineableElement` Record under `mining/mineableelements`. Several
elements may link to the same `ResourceType`, so none is picked for a commodity.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `agricium_ore`.

instability.description: `elementInstability`, from 0 to 1000 on LIVE; `null` when the Record states none.

resourceTypeGuid.description:
The GUID of the `ResourceType` Record the Reference `resourceType` links to. It equals a
commodity's `subtypeGuid` only when the catalog has that commodity (20 of the 41 linked
`ResourceType`s on LIVE). `null` for a null or dangling Reference.

MineableEntity.description:
A mineable entity: an `EntityClassDefinition` Record under `entities/mineable`, one kind of
rock or deposit. Many entities share a composition; a provider preset reaches an entity through
the `entityGuid` of its harvestables. Entities are selected by record path and type alone, so
one without the components below has `null` and empty fields.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `MineableRock_AsteroidLegendary_Quantainium`.

mineableCompositionGuid.description: The GUID of the `MineableComposition` Record `Components[MineableParams]` links to.

miningGlobalParamsGuid.description: The GUID of the `MiningGlobalParams` Record `Components[MineableParams]` links to.

radarContactTypeGuid.description: The GUID of the `RadarContactTypeEntry` Record `radarProperties.contactType` links to.

scanSignature.description:
The scan signature the mining scanner shows, from 3000 to 4900 on LIVE: the slot of
`signatures` that `signatureTypeParams` of the `RadarSystemGlobalParams` Record names
`@hud_scanning_info_rs_signature`. `null` when the Record states no signatures, all of them
are zero, `signatures` has not one number per signature type, or the Archive names no
such slot (a catalog warning says so).

signatures.description:
`radarProperties.baseSignatureParams.signatures` of `Components[SSCSignatureSystemParams]`
in stored order, one number per signature type; a value that is not a finite 32-bit float
is exported as 0. Empty when the Record states none.

MiningEffect.description:
The mining modifiers one `ItemMiningModifierParams` or `ItemMineableRockModifierParams`
applies.

lifetime.description: `modifierLifetime.lifetime`, in seconds; `null` for a modifier that lasts.

MiningGlobalParams.description:
The mining parameters of one kind of miner: a `MiningGlobalParams` Record under `mining`. Each
number is that of the Record, unchanged, and `null` when the Record states none. The effects,
sounds and the default explosion of the Record are not exported.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `miningglobalparamsship`.

wasteResourceTypeGuid.description:
The GUID of the `ResourceType` Record the Reference `wasteResourceType` links to; `null`
for a null Reference.

MiningLaserStats.description:
A mining laser, raw facts of `SEntityComponentMiningLaserParams` (ADR-0262).

The beams are fire modes of `weapon.fireActions`: their `hitType`, `fullDamageRange`,
`zeroDamageRange` and `damagePerSecond`.

throttleMinimum.description: `throttleMinimum`, the lowest throttle as a fraction of 1.

MiningModifierStats.description:
A mining module or gadget, raw facts of the `EntityComponentAttachableModifierParams` that
holds a mining modifier (ADR-0262).

activationMethod.description:
`activationMethod`, e.g. `ActivateOnAttach` for a passive module and `ActivateOnDemand`
for an active module or a gadget. A closed set the game may extend; the schema keeps a
string.

fireActionModifiers.description: The `ItemWeaponModifiersParams` in stored order: the multiplier per fire action.

laser.description: The first `ItemMiningModifierParams`: the change to the laser; `null` without one.

rock.description: The first `ItemMineableRockModifierParams`: the change to the rock; `null` without one.

`FloatModifierMultiplicative` as stored, in percent; `null` for a modifier the struct leaves
unset.

Ship.description:
A ship or ground vehicle: an `EntityClassDefinition` Record under `entities/spaceships` or
`entities/groundvehicles`.

cargoGridsWithIssue.description:
How many cargo grids of the default Loadout have no readable capacity, e.g. because their
container Record does not exist.

cargoScu.description:
The cargo capacity in standard cargo units (SCU) of the cargo grids the default Loadout
reaches, rounded to four decimals: 0 for a ship without a cargo grid, `null` when it has
grids and none can be read. With `cargoGridsWithIssue` above 0 the value is a lower bound.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `AEGS_Avenger_Titan`.

description.description: The description, from `vehicleDescription` of the vehicle parameters.

hullHealth.description:
The hull hit points: the sum of the positive `damageMax` of the structural parts of the
vehicle implementation, rounded to four decimals. `null` without a vehicle implementation
or when no part states a `damageMax`.

insurance.description:
The claim and expedite values of the ship's `SEntityInsuranceProperties`; `null` when the
Record has none.

manufacturerGuid.description:
The GUID of the manufacturer the Reference `manufacturer` links to, `null` for a null
Reference.

mass.description:
The hull mass in kilograms, without the Loadout, the docked vehicles and the landing gear:
the sum of the `mass` of the parts of the vehicle implementation after the Modification
the ship selects, rounded to four decimals. `null` when neither the parts nor the physics
controller state one, never 0.

massBasis.description:
What `mass` is the sum of. Today one of `parts` and `physics`; the schema keeps a string,
as a new value is additive. `null` exactly when `mass` is.

name.description: The name, from `vehicleName` of the vehicle parameters.

playability.description:
Who the ship is for, `null` when no rule applies. Today one of `player`, `ai`, `mission`
and `special`; the schema keeps a string, as a new value is additive.

size.description: The item size of `AttachDef.Size`, `null` without one.

variantOf.description:
The GUID of the base of the variant group the ship belongs to: the ships that share the
vehicle definition and the vehicle implementation after the Modification. `null` for a base
and for a ship that is alone in its group. It is the `guid` of an entry of `ships`.

vehicleDefinition.description: The path of the vehicle definition XML, `null` without one.

vehicleKind.description:
Spaceship or ground vehicle, `null` when the record path and the vehicle implementation
do not settle it. Today one of `spaceship` and `groundVehicle`; the schema keeps a string,
as a new value is additive.

ShipInsurance.description:
The insurance data of a ship: the `SEntityInsuranceProperties` of its
`StaticEntityClassData`, the numbers of its `ShipInsuranceParams`. The Record states no claim
cost; `expediteFee` is the only fee in aUEC.

baseWaitTimeMinutes.description:
`baseWaitTimeMinutes` in minutes; inferred meaning: the claim time. `null` when the Record
states none.

expediteFee.description:
`baseExpeditingFee` of the Record in aUEC, the only fee in the Record; `null` when the
Record states none.

mandatoryWaitTimeMinutes.description:
`mandatoryWaitTimeMinutes` in minutes; inferred meaning: the shortest claim time. `null`
when the Record states none.

restoreOnClaim.description:
`restoreOnClaim`, a boolean; inferred meaning: whether a claim restores the ship with its
Loadout. `null` when the Record states none.

shipEntityClassName.description:
`shipEntityClassName` of the insurance parameters, e.g. `AEGS_Gladius`; `null` when it is
empty.

ShipSpawnGroup.description: A group of ships that spawn together (`SpawnDescription_ShipGroup`).

name.description: The `Name` of the group, `null` when empty.

slots.description: The ships of the group, one slot each.

ShipSpawnOption.description: One alternative of a ship slot: a ship the game picks by tags.

concurrentAmount.description: The `concurrentAmount`: how many of the ship are alive at once; `null` when absent.

namePropertyVariable.description: The `missionVariableName` of the property the `nameProperty` points to, `null` when absent.

negativeTags.description: The `negativeTags` a match must not carry.

tags.description:
The `tags` the game searches ships and crew by: ship model, role, faction, cargo, spawn
flags.

weight.description: The `weight` of the alternative among its slot; `null` when absent.

ShipSpawnPool.description:
A ship spawn description of a contract: what a `MissionPropertyValue_ShipSpawnDescriptions`
property states, shared by every contract that states the same.

guid.description: The identifier of the content (see the catalog documentation); not a GUID of the Archive.

ShipSpawnSlot.description: The alternatives for one ship (`SpawnDescription_ShipOptions`): the game spawns one of them.

ShipStoreSlug.description: An RSI store slug and the ship it stands for.

className.description: The `className` of the ship the slug maps to, `null` for a retired slug.

retired.description:
Whether the slug's ship no longer exists in the game data; the slug stays so that a
pledge of it is recognised as retired.

rsiId.description: The ship id of the RSI store.

shipGuid.description: The `guid` of the ship of `ships` the slug maps to, `null` for a retired slug.

slug.description:
The slug of the ship in the RSI store, the last segment of its pledge URL, e.g.
`Aurora-Mk-I-ES`; entries are ordered by it.

storeName.description: The ship name as the RSI store shows it.

Shockwave.description: Original shockwave shape and material fields.

Shop.description:
A shop: one `ShopBackup` entry of the shop registry `Data\Libs\CosmoTools\LayerRecovery\
LayerBackups.xml`, one placement of an `SCShop` Entity in the world. No prices and no stock; the
item GUIDs come only from an inventory file that the shop containers name (ADR-0071).

body.description:
The second container, the body or jump point the shop is below (e.g.
`OOC_Stanton_4_Microtech`, `pyro5`); `null` when the chain has none.

commodityExchange.description:
Whether the shop is a commodity exchange or commodity terminal: `entityName` starts with
`SCShop_CommEx_TDD_`, or starts with `SCShop_Platinumbay` and ends with `_Commodity`.

containers.description:
The names of the containers from the system root down to the one that holds the shop,
from the `SuperName` chain without its GUIDs and without the `SCShop` Entity.

defaultValue.description:
The `DefaultValue` GUID of the registry entry; `null` when it is empty. Shops with the same
`registryName` share it.

entityGuid.description:
The `CryGUID` of the `SCShop` Entity, the last element of `key`. A shop module placed in
several places keeps it, so it is no identity; it is the `CryGUID` the container's
`entitycomponentshop.xml` names.

entityName.description:
The name of the `SCShop` Entity, the last element of the registry's `SuperName`, e.g.
`SCShop_CommEx_TDD_NewBabbage`. An internal name, not a localisation key.

inventory.description:
The lower-case file stem of `Data\Scripts\ShopInventories\<stem>.json` that the `.soc` of
every shop container naming `entityGuid` gives the `SCShop` component (ADR-0071); `null`
when no container names a file, the containers disagree or the file is missing or
unreadable.

itemGuids.description:
The `EntityClassDefinition` GUIDs of the items in that inventory file, lower case, ordered
and without repeats; `null` exactly when `inventory` is. No price, stock or rental data.

key.description:
The identity: the `ID` chain of the registry entry, the `CryGUID`s of the containers from
the system root down to the `SCShop` Entity, comma separated. Unique in the catalog.

kind.description:
The kind from the path of the shop container whose `SCShop` Entity is `entityGuid`:
the folder below `PU\Shops` (e.g. `commex`, `clothing`), or `shopcomm` or `shopfood` for a
container below `PU\loc`. A closed set the game may extend; `null` when no container or
containers of different kinds hold the Entity.

location.description:
The third container, the location (e.g. `Area18_City_objectContainer`); `null` when the
chain has none.

registryName.description:
The `ShopName` of the registry entry, e.g. `Pharmacy_RestStop_ARC-LEO1`; `null` when it is
empty. An internal name, not a localisation key. Many shops share one.

starmapObjectGuid.description:
The `guid` of the `starmapObjects` entry whose `entityName` or `className` equals
`location` ignoring ASCII case; `null` when none does or more than one object does.

system.description:
The star system whose registry holds the shop: the platform name without the suffix
`system`, e.g. `stanton`, `pyro`.
